description: Land Title Settlement Department - Village of Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Homagama, Colombo District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property titles, and land-related legal determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
